cards.meaning: touted, proudly showed off (something claimed as an achievement)
cards.example: Ipinagmalaki ni Trump ang kasunduan, pero wala pang napipirmahan.
cards.exampleMeaning: Trump touted the deal, but nothing has been signed yet.
cards.note: Mula sa 'malaki'. Mas neutral kaysa 'ipinagyabang' (may bahid ng kayabangan); kaya ito ang gamit ng mamamahayag. Positibo sa pamilya (ipinagmalaki ang anak), may pag-aalinlangan sa pulitika kapag walang patunay.
cards.tiesTo: Trump touts 'biggest trade deal' at Malacañang; nothing signed

cards.meaning: trimmed, sliced off (a forecast, budget or price)
cards.example: Tinapyas ng Moody's Analytics ang pagtataya sa paglago sa 2.4 porsiyento.
cards.exampleMeaning: Moody's Analytics trimmed its growth forecast to 2.4 percent.
cards.note: Mula sa 'tapyas' (hiwa sa gilid ng kahoy o tela). Iba sa 'pinutol' (buong naputol); sa 'tinapyas' may natira pa. Makulay na pamalit sa 'binawasan' sa balitang pang-ekonomiya.
cards.tiesTo: Moody's Analytics cuts PH 2026 growth to 2.4% from 3%

cards.meaning: to be mainly X; to rely chiefly on X
cards.example: 京东的利润增长以降本为主。
cards.examplePinyin: Jīngdōng de lìrùn zēngzhǎng yǐ jiàng běn wéi zhǔ.
cards.exampleMeaning: JD's profit growth comes mainly from cutting costs.
cards.note: 书面语(财报/政策报告)。搭配:以+投资/消费/出口/降本+为主。近义:主要靠(口语,同义);主要是 只标出主项,以…为主 框定整体结构、其余为次。
cards.tiesTo: JD Q3 profit recovery driven by cost cuts and logistics

cards.meaning: barely (managing, with strain); reluctantly / to force
cards.example: 这个季度，营收勉强增长了3.5%。
cards.note: 口语书面皆可。副词:勉强+增长/维持/及格。近义:刚好(中性,恰好达到) vs 勉强(吃力地达到)。动词义:别勉强自己(don't force yourself)。
cards.tiesTo: JD Q3 revenue +3.5% after Q2 decline
